component.name: Salvajocs
component.summary: Back up and restore game saves

description.p: Back up and restore game saves in a restic-format repository. A save backed up from a Wine or Proton prefix on Linux restores on native Windows, and the other way round.

It finds saves with the ludusavi game manifest, in native folders, Steam Proton prefixes and Wine prefixes you configure, and also backs up registry keys. The repository can be a local folder, a REST server, an rclone remote or an OpenDAL service, and you can read it with the restic command line.

screenshot.caption: Backup: scan for games and pick the ones to back up
Restore: preview every file and registry key before anything is written
Mapping dialog: where each folder goes on the other build of a game
Custom games: a game's paths, pairs and skipped folders

description.p: Each storage backend has its own named fields and a help link to its docs page. Other options are under Advanced options. Rclone remotes show in a list. The repository password is now called the encryption password. Compression is a dropdown with presets and a custom level.

A new look: green light and dark themes, a more readable font, icons, and a save bar on the Backup tab. Restore lists the games in a sidebar. Labels and messages are plainer, and keyboard and screen reader order follows the screen.
